arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالصّٰفّٰتِ صَفًّا
translation: By those who set the ranks in battle order
And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
And those who read (the Word) for a reminder
Lo! thy Lord is surely One

arabic: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما وَرَبُّ المَشٰرِقِ
transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi
translation: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings

arabic: إِنّا زَيَّنَّا السَّماءَ الدُّنيا بِزينَةٍ الكَواكِبِ
transliteration: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi
translation: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets
With security from every froward devil

arabic: لا يَسَّمَّعونَ إِلَى المَلَإِ الأَعلىٰ وَيُقذَفونَ مِن كُلِّ جانِبٍ
transliteration: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin
translation: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side
Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment

arabic: إِلّا مَن خَطِفَ الخَطفَةَ فَأَتبَعَهُ شِهابٌ ثاقِبٌ
transliteration: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun
translation: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame

arabic: فَاستَفتِهِم أَهُم أَشَدُّ خَلقًا أَم مَن خَلَقنا إِنّا خَلَقنٰهُم مِن طينٍ لازِبٍ
transliteration: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin
translation: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay
Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
And heed not when they are reminded
And seek to scoff when they behold a portent

arabic: وَقالوا إِن هٰذا إِلّا سِحرٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun
translation: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic

arabic: أَءِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَءِنّا لَمَبعوثونَ
transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
translation: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)
And our forefathers
Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low

arabic: فَإِنَّما هِىَ زَجرَةٌ وٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذا هُم يَنظُرونَ
transliteration: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona
translation: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold

transliteration: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni
translation: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment

arabic: هٰذا يَومُ الفَصلِ الَّذى كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبونَ
transliteration: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
translation: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny

arabic: احشُرُوا الَّذينَ ظَلَموا وَأَزوٰجَهُم وَما كانوا يَعبُدونَ
transliteration: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona
translation: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship

arabic: مِن دونِ اللَّهِ فَاهدوهُم إِلىٰ صِرٰطِ الجَحيمِ
transliteration: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi
translation: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell
And stop them, for they must be questioned
What aileth you that ye help not one another
Nay, but this day they make full submission
And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning

arabic: قالوا إِنَّكُم كُنتُم تَأتونَنا عَنِ اليَمينِ
transliteration: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni
translation: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth)
They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers

arabic: وَما كانَ لَنا عَلَيكُم مِن سُلطٰنٍ بَل كُنتُم قَومًا طٰغينَ
transliteration: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena
translation: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk

arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَينا قَولُ رَبِّنا إِنّا لَذائِقونَ
transliteration: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona
translation: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom)
Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray
Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom
Lo! thus deal We with the guilty

arabic: إِنَّهُم كانوا إِذا قيلَ لَهُم لا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَستَكبِرونَ
transliteration: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona
translation: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful

arabic: وَيَقولونَ أَئِنّا لَتارِكوا ءالِهَتِنا لِشاعِرٍ مَجنونٍ
transliteration: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin
translation: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet
Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him)
Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom

arabic: وَما تُجزَونَ إِلّا ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
transliteration: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
translation: Ye are requited naught save what ye did
Save single-minded slaves of Allah
For them there is a known provision
Fruits. And they will be honoured
In the Gardens of delight
On couches facing one another
A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them
White, delicious to the drinkers

arabic: لا فيها غَولٌ وَلا هُم عَنها يُنزَفونَ
transliteration: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona
translation: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby
And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes
(Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich)
And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning

arabic: قالَ قائِلٌ مِنهُم إِنّى كانَ لى قَرينٌ
transliteration: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun
translation: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)

arabic: أَءِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَءِنّا لَمَدينونَ
transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona
translation: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book
He saith: Will ye look
Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell
He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin

arabic: وَلَولا نِعمَةُ رَبّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ المُحضَرينَ
transliteration: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena
translation: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom)
Are we then not to die

arabic: إِلّا مَوتَتَنَا الأولىٰ وَما نَحنُ بِمُعَذَّبينَ
transliteration: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena
translation: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished
Lo! this is the supreme triumph
For the like of this, then, let the workers work

arabic: أَذٰلِكَ خَيرٌ نُزُلًا أَم شَجَرَةُ الزَّقّومِ
transliteration: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi
translation: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum
Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers

arabic: إِنَّها شَجَرَةٌ تَخرُجُ فى أَصلِ الجَحيمِ
transliteration: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi
translation: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell
Its crop is as it were the heads of devils

arabic: فَإِنَّهُم لَءاكِلونَ مِنها فَمالِـٔونَ مِنهَا البُطونَ
transliteration: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona
translation: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُم عَلَيها لَشَوبًا مِن حَميمٍ
transliteration: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin
translation: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell
They indeed found their fathers astray
But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps
And verily most of the men of old went astray before them
And verily We sent among them warners
Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned
Save single-minded slaves of Allah
And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
And We saved him and his household from the great distress
And made his seed the survivors
And left for him among the later folk (the salutation)
Peace be unto Noah among the peoples
Lo! thus do We reward the good
Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves
Then We did drown the others
And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart

arabic: إِذ قالَ لِأَبيهِ وَقَومِهِ ماذا تَعبُدونَ
transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona
translation: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship
Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire
What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds
And he glanced a glance at the stars
Then said: Lo! I feel sick
And they turned their backs and went away from him

arabic: فَراغَ إِلىٰ ءالِهَتِهِم فَقالَ أَلا تَأكُلونَ
transliteration: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona
translation: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat
What aileth you that ye speak not
Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand
And (his people) came toward him, hastening
He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
When Allah hath created you and what ye make

arabic: قالُوا ابنوا لَهُ بُنيٰنًا فَأَلقوهُ فِى الجَحيمِ
transliteration: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi
translation: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire
And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost

arabic: وَقالَ إِنّى ذاهِبٌ إِلىٰ رَبّى سَيَهدينِ
transliteration: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni
translation: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me
My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous
So We gave him tidings of a gentle son

arabic: فَلَمّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعىَ قالَ يٰبُنَىَّ إِنّى أَرىٰ فِى المَنامِ أَنّى أَذبَحُكَ فَانظُر ماذا تَرىٰ قالَ يٰأَبَتِ افعَل ما تُؤمَرُ سَتَجِدُنى إِن شاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصّٰبِرينَ
transliteration: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena
translation: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast
Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face
We called unto him: O Abraham

arabic: قَد صَدَّقتَ الرُّءيا إِنّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجزِى المُحسِنينَ
transliteration: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
translation: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good
Lo! that verily was a clear test
Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim
And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation)
Peace be unto Abraham
Thus do We reward the good
Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves
And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous

arabic: وَبٰرَكنا عَلَيهِ وَعَلىٰ إِسحٰقَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِما مُحسِنٌ وَظالِمٌ لِنَفسِهِ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun
translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves
And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron
And saved them and their people from the great distress
And helped them so that they became the victors
And We gave them the clear Scripture
And showed them the right path
And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation)
Peace be unto Moses and Aaron
Lo! thus do We reward the good
Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves
And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn)
When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators
Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers
But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
Save single-minded slaves of Allah
And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation)
Peace be unto Elias
Lo! thus do We reward the good
Lo! he is one of our believing slaves
And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn)
When We saved him and his household, every one
Save an old woman among those who stayed behind
Then We destroyed the others
And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning
And at night-time; have ye then no sense
And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
When he fled unto the laden ship
And then drew lots and was of those rejected
And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy
And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)

arabic: لَلَبِثَ فى بَطنِهِ إِلىٰ يَومِ يُبعَثونَ
transliteration: Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona
translation: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised
Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick
And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him

arabic: وَأَرسَلنٰهُ إِلىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلفٍ أَو يَزيدونَ
transliteration: Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona
translation: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while
Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons

arabic: أَم خَلَقنَا المَلٰئِكَةَ إِنٰثًا وَهُم شٰهِدونَ
transliteration: Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona
translation: Or created We the angels females while they were present
Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say
Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie
(And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons
What aileth you? How judge ye
Will ye not then reflect
Or have ye a clear warrant
Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful

arabic: وَجَعَلوا بَينَهُ وَبَينَ الجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَد عَلِمَتِ الجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُم لَمُحضَرونَ
transliteration: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona
translation: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him)
Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him)
Save single-minded slaves of Allah
Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship
Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him
Save him who is to burn in hell

arabic: وَما مِنّا إِلّا لَهُ مَقامٌ مَعلومٌ
transliteration: Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun
translation: There is not one of us but hath his known position
Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks
Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
And indeed they used to say

arabic: لَو أَنَّ عِندَنا ذِكرًا مِنَ الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena
translation: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
We would be single-minded slaves of Allah
Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know
And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
That they verily would be helped
And that Our host, they verily would be the victors
So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile
And watch, for they will (soon) see
Would they hasten on Our doom

arabic: فَإِذا نَزَلَ بِساحَتِهِم فَساءَ صَباحُ المُنذَرينَ
transliteration: Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena
translation: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned
Withdraw from them awhile
And watch, for they will (soon) see

arabic: سُبحٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ العِزَّةِ عَمّا يَصِفونَ
transliteration: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona
translation: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
And peace be unto those sent (to warn)
And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds
